# Shark Attacks

The Global Shark Attack File is a database that records shark-human interactions from around the world. It includes details such as the country, activity, year, and whether an attack was fatal.

Fear of sharks is often out of proportion to the actual risk. Shark attacks are rare, and most encounters do not cause death, even though dramatic stories can make them seem common.

Use the **Map** page to see where attacks have been recorded and the **Trends** page to explore how attacks vary across years and activities.
